reading.zh: 这层按一局的时间线读：run-flow 受理派遣并开启局内会话；encounter 在其中推进战斗；interaction 与 village 是场景侧玩法（局内地图的交互寻路、实体村庄的生产循环）；meta-events 与 team-supply 把奖励、市场交易与队伍状态结算回存档。team-supply 是计划态占位，等对应代码抽出后再落地。
reading.en: Read this layer as a run's timeline. run-flow accepts the dispatch and opens the run session; encounter runs the fighting inside it; interaction and village are the scene-side play (interacting/pathfinding in the run map, and the physical village production loop); meta-events and team-supply close the loop by settling rewards, market trades and team state back into saves. team-supply is a planned placeholder until that code is extracted.

title.zh: 场景内玩法：交互与村庄
